title: Restock inventory
prompt: restock(inventory, deliveries) adds delivered quantities to an inventory dict. New items are allowed, and quantities sometimes arrive as text like "4". It crashes in two different ways.
hints: There are two separate TypeErrors. Test a new item and a text quantity separately.
dict.get(key) returns None when the key is missing, and None + 2 fails.
Give .get a default of 0, and convert qty with int(qty).
explanation: dict.get(item) returned None for new items, and string quantities could not be added to ints. The fix is inventory.get(item, 0) + int(qty).
